transcript:
User: This is Frank. Whoever you people are, I want to know how you got this number.
Agent: Frank, I hear you—that’s a fair question. Did you see us from an ad or search for anything like “missed calls” or “after-hours answering,” or did someone leave you a voicemail?
User: None of your damn business. You people are all liars and thieves.
Agent: I hear you, Frank—I’m not here to argue with you. Would you like me to stop contacting you going forward?
User: Well, maybe you're not all crooks. Leave your number, I might look you up.
Agent: I get it—but I can’t leave a personal number from this line. What’s the best place to look us up: did you want the company name “Dialux,” or the website?
User: None of your damn business. I'll find it if I want to. Don't call again.
Agent: Got it, Frank—I won’t contact you again. Take care.
